verdict.rationale: Skyvern can be driven entirely by code with no UI. Runs are started through the REST API or the Python/TypeScript SDKs against a cloud browser, authenticated with API keys and reported back via a webhook on completion. It can also be self-hosted with pip, Docker Compose or Kubernetes, and the docs pitch it for end-to-end browser tests. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g., a GitHub Actions example), an explicit headless-mode or CLI reference, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
